The qualification represents an important milestone in OSS's strategy to expand its presence in the enterprise AI market, making its high-performance computing technology available to organizations seeking to integrate advanced AI capabilities into their existing infrastructure. As businesses move beyond AI experimentation toward broader deployment, demand is growing for computing solutions that can handle increasingly complex workloads while preserving existing technology investments. OSS's technology addresses this need by enabling enterprise customers to add substantial AI processing capacity to their existing computing environments without the need to replace their core server systems. Mike Knowles, President and CEO of OSS, said, “This qualification represents an important milestone for OSS and further validates the value of our high-performance computing technology in addressing the rapidly evolving needs of the enterprise AI market. By making our technology available through an established global computing ecosystem, we are expanding our reach into new markets and creating opportunities to support a broader base of enterprise, commercial, and datacenter customers. We believe this development reinforces our strategy to leverage our core technical capabilities across multiple high-growth AI markets.” At the center of the solution is OSS's Gen5 4UP-MAX expansion system, which enables enterprise customers to integrate up to eight high-performance, 675W AI accelerators from leading manufacturers directly into their existing server infrastructure, with the flexibility to scale computing capacity by connecting multiple expansion systems to a single server. Designed to support demanding AI workloads, including model training, fine-tuning, and inference, the platform combines substantial computing capacity with advanced data center management capabilities through OSS's U-BMC technology, providing enhanced system monitoring and control. The solution also supports confidential computing, helping protect sensitive data during AI processing. Advanced power and cooling architectures are designed to support sustained performance under demanding AI workloads. Combined, these capabilities provide organizations with a scalable, secure, and manageable approach to expanding AI computing performance. Jim Ison, Chief Product Officer of OSS, said, “As enterprises move from experimenting with AI to deploying it across their operations, they need solutions that deliver greater computing power without sacrificing security, reliability, or manageability. Our solution addresses these requirements by combining exceptional processing capacity with the flexibility to scale as customer needs evolve. By integrating high-density acceleration, advanced system management, and purpose-built power and cooling capabilities, we provide a differentiated solution for increasingly demanding enterprise AI applications. This is particularly important for organizations looking to accelerate AI adoption while maximizing their existing infrastructure investments.” About One Stop SystemsOne Stop Systems, Inc. (Nasdaq: OSS) is a leader in AI enabled solutions for the demanding 'edge'. OSS designs and manufactures Enterprise Class compute and storage products that enable rugged AI, sensor fusion and autonomous capabilities without compromise. These hardware and software platforms bring the latest data center performance to harsh and challenging applications, whether they are on land, sea or in the air. OSS products include ruggedized servers, compute accelerators, flash storage arrays, and storage acceleration software. These specialized compact products are used across multiple industries and applications, including autonomous trucking and farming, as well as aircraft, drones, ships and vehicles within the defense industry. OSS solutions address the overall AI workflow, from high-speed data acquisition to deep learning, training and large-scale inference, and have delivered many industry firsts for industrial OEM and government customers. As one of the fastest growing segments of the multi-billion-dollar edge computing market, AI enabled solutions require-and OSS delivers-the highest level of performance in the most challenging environments without compromise. OSS products are available directly or through global distributors. For more information, go to www.onestopsystems.com. You can also follow OSS on X, YouTube, and LinkedIn.
